name: standardized-bug-tests
goal: Diagnose existing coverage gaps and strengthen standardized tests before repair in framework and app

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Existing tests checked loop titles and app permissions but never asserted coverage-gap diagnosis or standardized test reuse; fix inherited implementation-before-test. Strengthened existing loop and app integration tests reproduce those omissions.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Before implementation, existing framework tests failed 12/19 for absent coverage-first behavior; existing app run integration tests failed 2/9 because actual Plan and Change prompts omitted the policy. Test SHA256 values frozen at /tmp/harness-standardized-bug-tests-tests.sha256.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Shared bug repair policy now reaches generated guidance and actual app Plan/Change prompts. New fix, bug-fix and prevention loops require coverage diagnosis and enforce completion order. Existing loop history is retained.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same unchanged strengthened tests: framework 19/19 and app integration 9/9 pass; adjacent app reply/reference coverage totals 15/15. All four frozen test-file SHA256 checks pass.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Complete bun run check passed with two workers: formatting, types, lint, native/Wasm, unit and CLI suites, packaging, registry/audits and every workspace, including 172 desktop browser cases. regression.proof trace retains exact commands, original failing assertions and the unchanged test hashes. Live-provider, scale and simulator-build opt-ins were skipped by the normal suite; installed app release is pending.
